options.name: running_config
options.description: This option is used only with state I(parsed). The value of this option should be the output received from the NX-OS device by executing the command B(show running-config | section ^interface) The state I(parsed) reads the configuration from C(running_config) option and transforms it into Ansible structured data as per the resource module's argspec and the value is then returned in the I(parsed) key within the result.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the configuration after module completion The state I(rendered) considers the system default mode for interfaces to be "Layer 3" and the system default state for interfaces to be shutdown. The state I(purged) negates virtual interfaces that are specified in task from running-config.
